create_MocapDataset: create a MocapDataset instance by loading motion capture data from a numpy file path with a skeleton and fps
downsample_MocapDataset: downsample a MocapDataset by an integer factor to reduce frame rate while keeping all stride variants
mirror_MocapDataset: mirror all sequences in a MocapDataset for data augmentation by flipping left and right joints
compute_euler_angles_MocapDataset: compute euler angles for all rotations in a MocapDataset given a rotation axis order string
compute_positions_MocapDataset: compute world and local joint positions for all sequences in a MocapDataset using forward kinematics
